root_cause_label: Unable to install pyarrow on Python 3.13 venv lacking pip; no pre-built wheel available and source build failed
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent spent all 27 steps cycling through ineffective strategies to install pyarrow (missing pip in venv, unavailable apt package python3-pyarrow, source build crashing on Python 3.13, runtime crash), never successfully reading the parquet data and never starting the actual benchmark creation task.
t_err_evidence: python -m pip install --no-cache-dir pyarrow -q && python ... df_examples=pd.read_parquet(ex)
t_commit_evidence: Step 9 output '/opt/openhands-venv/bin/python: No module named pip' locks in failure — the venv has no pip, pyarrow is not in apt as python3-pyarrow on bookworm, and subsequent attempts (ensurepip + source build, apt, IPython) all fail or crash, meaning the agent never resolved the dependency in 27 steps.
t_surface_evidence: /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python: No module named pip [The command completed with exit code 1.]
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge that the Python 3.13 venv at /opt/openhands-venv had no pip module installed, and that pyarrow==15.0.2/14.0.2 had no pre-built wheels for Python 3.13 on that platform, meaning source builds would fail. It also did not know that apt lacked a python3-pyarrow package on Debian bookworm. A knowledgeable agent would have checked Python version compatibility for pyarrow wheels or used `uv pip install` or `fastparquet` as an alternative.
forewarning_evidence: Parquet read failed for examples: ... Missing optional dependency 'pyarrow'. pyarrow is required for parquet support.
